parts.name: Lens
parts.Basic_description: This is the lens of the camera, made primarily of optical glass. It is a cylindrical component located at the front of the camera.
parts.Functional_description: The lens focuses light onto the camera sensor or film, determining image clarity and focus.
parts.Movement_description: It can move slightly for focusing or zooming, depending on the camera design.

parts.name: Button
parts.Basic_description: This is the shutter button of the camera, made of durable plastic and located on the top surface.
parts.Functional_description: It is used to trigger the camera shutter, capturing an image when pressed.
parts.Movement_description: It moves vertically when pressed and returns to its original position via a spring mechanism.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the main body of the camera, made of aluminum for strength and lightweight durability.
parts.Functional_description: It houses all internal components, including the sensor, battery, and circuitry, providing structural integrity.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and serves as the rigid frame for the entire camera assembly.
